Country music star Billy Ray Cyrus and Kim Russo visit a plantation in Tennessee where Billy came across an otherworldly spirit. Through Kim, Billy uncovers the true identity of the ghost and a shocking revelation.
Greg Grunberg seeks out the help of psychic medium Kim Russo.

Academy award-winning actress Tatum O'Neal revisits the Brooklyn townhouse where she had a life changing paranormal experience. With Medium Kim Russo's help, they uncover urgent messages for Tatum coming from the other side.
Actor Richard Burgi returns to his childhood home in NJ where he and his family encountered the paranormal.
Kendra Wilkinson (The Girls Next Door, Kendra on Top) is desperate to know what or who was behind the paranormal encounters she had at her former home in Pasadena, CA.
Actress Jordan Ladd (Cabin Fever, Grindhouse) anxiously returns to an old mansion in New Jersey where she once encountered a ghost as it was watching her sleep.
Young Christopher Knight is visited by the spirit of a tormented girl. And more.
Deborah Gibson receives a message from the ghost of her idol; a murdered matriarch terrorizes Joey Pantoliano and his girlfriend.

Yvette Fielding and her team take on a three-part investigation that tests them to the very core. A place that surprised intrigued and terrified the hardened team, making Standon Hall the most fearful place they have investigated.

Part two of this mammoth investigation and Yvette has some harsh words for Karl as he decides to take a risk that proves too dangerous. With something that wants them out, the investigation gets aggressive.
The concluding part of the team’s most scary investigation to date, but will they last the night as something definitely wants them out.
The team take on one of the grandest properties in Great Britain, Liverpool’s Croxteth Hall in a non-stop two-hour heart pounding investigation.

We stay with the team and find out what happened after we left them last time. The team seem to be stalked by something…but what. Only time will tell what awaits them in the upper corridors of this once grand mansion.

The team head to the centre of Shrewsbury and a large building that is all but empty. The house is now said to be full of the long dead just wanting to make itself known and that is exactly what they did.
A haunted old building in West Yorkshire almost halts the investigation due to violent poltergeist activity. The team must decide whether to continue, and when they do, the situation worsens.

An old house in England’s West Midlands gives the Most Haunted team a night they will never forget. Yvette is under attack by something that wants to gain her attention and the team catch one of the best pieces of evidence to date.

The strange occurrences at Hayden Hill House switch up a gear as whatever is there seems now to be stalking the team with some terrifying results, at least for some of the crew it is proving too much.

This week Yvette Fielding takes her Most Haunted team to Coalville and a house that is surrounded by mystery. The team seem to disturb the rest of some of its long-term residence as they battle through a night of terror.
Once an old foundry, this large old building houses vehicles from a bygone era that are said to still contain passengers whose destination has never ended.
Yvette heads to Presteigne, Mid Wales and the famous Judges Lodgings, were courts were held, people imprisoned and Judges stayed, but it also holds many a secret.
Most Haunted continues its investigation into the Judges Lodgings where the team seem to be under attack and something is trying to get through a door…but what?
This episode features the following cases: The Candlestick, The Diner, From the Agency, The Magic Rose Garden, The Jeep.
